item.description: Good morning, Sydney! It’s Friday, May 1st, 2026, and welcome to your Daily Drive. The sun is shining, the weekend is practically here, and with only a few days until Mother's Day, it's the perfect time to start planning something special for Mum. Did you know that the first-ever Australian Grand Prix was held in 1928, right here in Camden? Let's power through this last day and make it a great one!
